reading_note: The teaching describes how the entire host of evil affections and falsities — the "archonic host" — is distributed into four discrete registers of containment, and especially how the most active register (the sphere of stars / Wheel) operates as a cyclic process binding self-love's powers so that ascending good and truth from the natural can be received upward and what falls back is dispersed. The single arc: self-love and its falsities, being too violent for heaven or earth to bear, are bound onto the cyclic process of states (the Wheel/zodiac) where they are held facing one another in equilibrium, serving as the very mechanism by which divine truth is liberated. The ruling love of self ("the king") is shown as proportionate in might to its whole entourage, and through the seven guides and twelve states the whole creation is moved — strife, captivity, hunger, desire all circulating through these governing affections.
